claims.sentence: You can apply for admission to additional professional programs throughout the entire calendar year
The deadline for submitting your documents is until the start of studies, unless the implementation conditions of your specific program state otherwise
To enroll, you must submit an application for admission addressed to the Director of the University
When you submit this application, you must provide the required documents
You can submit these documents to the University in one of the following ways
The University official or structural unit responsible for implementing your program will receive your documents
Admission is conducted without entrance exams based on a review of your submitted documents, unless your educational program provides otherwise
The evidence does not specify the exact list of documents you must provide when submitting your application
It does not list the specific ways you can submit your documents
It does not state which official or structural unit will receive your documents for any given program
It does not indicate which programs might require entrance exams or what those requirements would be
